scope: Evaluation only, created after first-run seal. Never an inference or rigging input.
limitations: Reference face1 contains ink, not full eye/iris/skin semantic masks. Report recall of ink ownership, never full-part IoU.
Pixel-aligned neutral composition must be checked before using these masks.
Region boxes are manually reviewed evaluation annotations, not independent limb masks.
Set2 fuses hair, body, clothing, arms and hands; no independent hair/limb/neck split exists.
Face base supplies authored concealed facial skin only, not anatomical ground truth.
Image left/right are viewing coordinates, not inferred anatomical labels.
